verdict.rationale: Docs describe native integrations with Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com allowing the agent to update statuses, add comments, link PRs, and be triggered via mentions on issues/tickets (codegen-docs-3, codegen-docs-10, codegen-docs-23, codegen-docs-28), directly supporting task assignment from an existing ticket. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the workflow and more detail on the exact assignment UX beyond mention-triggering.
